architecture.contexts: six body residue classes and six checksum ordinals, all derived from coordinate mod 32
architecture.normalization: for every c,i, sum_(y,j) A[c,y,i,j]=65535 exactly
architecture.fit: Jeffreys-smoothed transition weights on train; select topology on untouched validation after physical model-page and termination charge

synthetic_fixture.suffix_population_result: all suffix depths <=25 require exactly 1 bit/symbol

physical_ledger.cold_rule: one global model page union plus worst-unaligned contiguous selected local frame

capacity.warning: cut information does not upper-bound total savings when a state is queried repeatedly or reset and reused

claim_boundary: A negative closes only this reset-32, unifilar parity-bank, chi<=64 finite packet; it does not close arbitrary nonnegative/Born MPS, TTN, non-unifilar HMM, longer reset, other public context, or lossy RD gains. A synthetic pass is not Qwen evidence.
